markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn

Conformal set holds Benign only, input is typical, and the second model agrees. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, Normal 2%, InSitu 2% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Benign only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996 / 64th percentile | Typical, reliable input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Benign [F5] | Moderate; two are Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Scored well below typical; small negative concept-model contribution · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 7) · ↓ invasive · Scored above typical; spot check 0/20 [F3] · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored low; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (0.54 logit drop, 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (0.002, −0.005 to 0.007); not shown faithful. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Calibration error is 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18) on a small test set; 96% may be off.
- Cell measures come from 3 regions flagged for too few tumor nuclei.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 9**: Confirm gland formation looks benign, not invasive architecture.
2. **Regions 0, 7**: Judge the two-layered lobules yourself; the model's spot check failed.
3. **Region 11**: Look for mitotic figures; the model's mitosis score is unreliable.
